about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. Checked by the facts gate against the source page; from video/studio/research/runs/2026-10-28-topic-bank.md (T2, lesson 2 in the bank) and re-read on the source page on Oct 28, 2026.

servicetitan.title: The Profile of a Top Performer: Four Behaviors That Set the Top 10% of Contractors Apart
servicetitan.topDefinition: Top performers were defined as contractors in the 90th percentile of revenue within their trade and market segment.
servicetitan.quote: Top performers close 77% of their estimates during the same visit. For the rest, that number is 62%. The 15-point gap comes down to momentum.
servicetitan.whyQuote: The longer the window between a quote and a decision, the more time a customer has to call a competitor, get distracted, or talk themselves out of the project entirely.
servicetitan.measuresQuote: Same-visit close rates measure something specific: how well a technician handles objections, frames financing and asks for the sale in the moment.
servicetitan.trades: commercial and residential contractors across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, garage door, water treatment, and other specialty trades
servicetitan.method: internal analysis of aggregated, anonymized data from participating ServiceTitan customers, trailing 12 months through January 2026; no sample size given
servicetitan.caveat: These metrics describe behaviors correlated with higher performance and do not imply that any specific product feature or practice caused the observed outcomes. Results reflect platform-wide patterns among participating ServiceTitan customers; individual results will vary.
servicetitan.scope: The page does not say whether the same-visit close rate is residential only; it says certain metrics apply to residential jobs only and ties only good-better-best to residential jobs. So the video says 'estimates', never 'home jobs'.
